reasoning: The Jacobian matrix is [[1,0,0],[0,3v²,3w²],[0,1,1]], whose determinant is 3(v²-w²)=3(v-w)(v+w). It vanishes exactly when v=w or v=-w, so all critical points form the union of these two planes, choice b. No captured Math Academy answer or grade establishes its stated key.

answers.correct_value: The critical points lie on the planes $v=\pm w.$
answers.wrong_value: The critical points lie on the plane $v=2w.$
